name: RW07-B6 Teams and evidence reporter
description: RW07-B6 (RW07 real-world test). Builds the incident timeline and the before/after workbook for the 10 incidents, attaches the sanitized evidence to each QA ticket, posts the summary to the QA Teams channel and checks it is there, reconciles the command ids and their cost, scans the outputs for the secret canary and confirms no disposable instance is left in a changed state.

variables.description: Address of the local QA stand-in server (127.0.0.1 only).

variables.description: Show message boxes and pause between records so a person can follow the run.

variables.description: Pause after each record when watch is on.

variables.description: none, or resilience: the stand-ins inject the five failures of runbook step 09.

variables.name: exceptions
variables.description: Records routed to the exception list.

variables.name: status
variables.description: success when every record was handled (routed exceptions included).

variables.name: result_file
variables.description: CSV file with one row per record.

args.text: What this agent does: Builds the incident timeline and the before/after workbook for the 10 incidents, attaches the sanitized evidence to each QA ticket, posts the summary to the QA Teams channel and checks it is there, reconciles the command ids and their cost, scans the outputs for the secret canary and confirms no disposable instance is left in a changed state. It works through 10 incident bundles and writes its results to the run's output folder.
